checking.headline: Checking…
checking.said: Asking the API how the arena is doing.

down.headline: The API is {word}.
down.said: This site cannot read anything. The pages you have open loaded earlier and may be out of date.

arena.say: We cannot tell. The arena reports through the API, and the API is not reporting.

api.say: The last read did not complete. This is ours to fix.

answering.saySlow: Reads are slow: this one took {ms}.
answering.say: Every read this site makes is answering.

stopped.headline: The arena has {word}.
stopped.said: No match has finished for {ago}, and {queue} matches are waiting. The API is answering, so the standings you see are correct but frozen.

arena.say: Matches wait in the queue and none finishes. Nothing is lost, and the runners work through the queue when they come back.

behind.headline: The arena is {word}.
behind.saidCounting: Runners are playing matches, but we are rating them slower than they finish, so a new result may take a few minutes to reach the ladder.
behind.said: Runners are playing matches slower than we queue them, so a new result may take a few minutes to show up.

arena.sayCounting: {n} finished matches are waiting for their ratings. Nothing is lost; the results will arrive late.
arena.say: The queue fills faster than runners clear it. Nothing is lost; the results will arrive late.

running.headline: Everything is {word}.
running.said: The arena is playing matches and the API is answering. {n} matches finished in the last hour.

arena.say: Pairing, play and rating are keeping up.

api.title: The API
api.measured: Your browser measures these numbers itself.

safe.title: Your work is safe.
safe.body: The database holds versions, ratings and finished matches, and you lose none of them while the API is down. Submissions fail until it returns. Try again then, and submit once.

late.title: Your results will arrive late.
late.bodyCounting: Your submitted versions keep their admission and their place in the queue, and their trials will run. A finished match may show {counting} for longer than usual. We keep each result, and the ratings will be correct when they land.
late.body: Your submitted versions keep their admission and their place in the queue, and their trials will run. We keep each result, and the ratings you see are correct.

inFlight.title: Versions in flight.
inFlight.body: {admitting} in admission and {trialling} waiting for a trial, as usual in a live season. If your version has not moved, these numbers tell you how busy admission and trials are.

meaning.title: The arena and the API
meaning.arena: The **arena** runs when we are pairing, playing and rating matches. If it stops, you lose nothing: versions stay active, ratings stay put, and the runners work through the queue when it comes back.
meaning.api: This website reads the **API**. If the API stops answering, the site cannot show a leaderboard even while the arena plays on behind it, so this page reports the two apart.
